## About
J&A Auto Parts serves the Phoenix area with quality used parts. It's not a fancy place. It's a junkyard, with vehicles stacked on each other and a whole wall built from engines and transmissions.
If you're hunting for a hard-to-find part, give us a call. Customers tell us our team is helpful, knowledgeable and quick to track down what they need, and you can pull the part on your own or pay a helper to pull it for you.
We're rated 4 stars from 52 Google reviews.

## Services
- Quality used parts: Parts pulled from the cars and trucks in our yard, for customers around Phoenix.
- Engines and transmissions: We keep a big stock of engines and transmissions on the lot. Customers have come to us for specific engines and transfer cases.
- Me pull it or helper pull it: Ask at the office for a me pull it price, or a helper pull it price if you'd rather one of our helpers pull the part.

## FAQ
Q: When are you open?
A: We're open Monday to Friday and on Saturday. Give us a call to check times before you head over.

Q: Can I see the part on the vehicle before I buy it?
A: Yes. Call ahead about the part you need, and when you get here a helper can walk you out to the vehicle to check that it's still there.
